title: Yerevan march concerning Artsakh recognition and ceasefire
location: Yerevan; route reported near embassies of Greece, Syria, and China, ending at Liberty Square
scope: One reported march on 16 October; possible relationship to a separate UN-office protest that day is unverified.
participants_original: NEWS.am describes citizens in a demonstration but gives no attendance estimate.
threshold_50_evidence: No count or qualifying crowd-size description found. The reported gathering is not demonstrated to have had 50 or more participants.

start_date.summary: NEWS.am reports the march as an event on 16 October 2020 and states it ended at Liberty Square.

location.summary: Reported near several embassies in Yerevan and ending at Liberty Square; exact route not given.

demands.summary: Artsakh recognition and maintenance of a humanitarian/lasting ceasefire are described.

participants.summary: Citizens are mentioned, but no count or estimate is supplied.

state_target.summary: The reported route is near foreign embassies; the source does not say whether any demand was directed to Armenia’s government.

notes: Retained for review because the action occurred in Armenia and voiced political demands, while the reported route/addressees are foreign missions. No independent evidence supports inclusion against Armenia’s own state/policy. Do not infer a 50-person crowd from the plural term citizens.
open_questions: Were demands directed to the Armenian state as well as foreign missions?
Did the gathering meet the 50-person threshold?
Was this march distinct from or connected to the 16 October UN-office protest?
Exact starting point, route, start time, organizer, and end of any wider action are unknown.
